mapper.sql: c.id, c.contract_no, c.name, c.customer_id, cu.name AS customer_name, c.business_id, b.name AS business_name, c.project_id, p.project_name, c.owner_user_id, u.username AS owner_username, c.amount, c.sign_date, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.status, c.remark, c.created_at, c.updated_at

FROM crm_contract c JOIN ent_enterprise cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_business b ON b.id = c.business_id LEFT JOIN crm_project p ON p.id = c.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.owner_user_id

sql.if: AND (c.name LIKE #{keyword} OR c.contract_no LIKE #{keyword} OR cu.name LIKE #{keyword} OR b.name LIKE #{keyword})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_contract (contract_no, name, customer_id, business_id, project_id, owner_user_id, amount, sign_date, start_date, end_date, status, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{contractNo}, #{name}, #{customer}, #{business}, #{project}, #{owner}, #{amount}, #{signDate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{actor})
